title: German Fish Wrap
description: A delicious combination of fish and German flavors wrapped in a mildly sweet wrap.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
Add the fish to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Lay the wrap flat and spread the German mustard evenly.
Add the cooked fish, cucumber, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and sliced red onion on top of the mustard.
Sprinkle the German cheese and fresh dill over the vegetables.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
